entries.title: A crewmate's picture of a scrolled page shows what is on screen
entries.body: When a crewmate scrolled down a web page and took a picture, the top of the picture could come out blank. The picture now shows the part of the page that was actually on screen.
entries.noPicture: The app's own screens do not change; the fix shows in the pictures a crewmate takes of web pages.

exclusions.reason: What the first mate and a crewmate are told about saving a document a website offers once; nothing on screen changes.
